title: Answer: takes no position on free will, the model depicts a will

statements.text: AST does not use consciousness to mean the part that has free will and chooses, and takes no position on free will. Its account of agency is that the self-model depicts an inner essence that can take possession of items and empower one to decide and act.

sources.quote: To some it refers specifically to the part inside you that has free will and chooses one action over another. I mean none of these things.

sources.locator: A Theory of Consciousness that Embodies Principles 1 and 2
sources.quote: take vivid mental possession of items, and empower oneself to decide and to act
